purpose: 根据发布材料准备发布公告
description: Create and optionally deliver grounded release announcements from a published Release Package across available channels; never owns changelog generation.

purpose: 归档已完成的里程碑并保留依据
description: Archive completed roadmap work packages or iteration/phase/version/period snapshots while preserving milestone event evidence and unfinished work.

purpose: 依据研究判断产品机会
description: Assess a product opportunity from existing research reports and user signals, producing a restrained, traceable decision layer.

purpose: 发现并运行项目测试
description: Discover and execute repository test commands safely with evidence-based command selection and safety guardrails.

purpose: 将需求与问题记录为工作项
description: Capture requirements, bugs, or issues from free-form input into structured, persistent artifacts. Use when user wants to record a work item quickly without deep validation.

purpose: 根据已确认的发布材料制作变更视频
description: Generate and validate an optional release video from confirmed Release Package change items using repository-local media tooling; never installs tools or decides or publishes the release.

purpose: 创建范围清晰、便于审阅的提交
description: Create high-quality git commits with clear messages and logical scope. Core goal - produce reviewable commits following Conventional Commits format with pre-commit quality checks.

purpose: 依据可追溯证据比较竞品
description: Compare a dated competitor set by capabilities, positioning, pricing, and evidence quality without treating undocumented features as absent.

purpose: 按契约消费并处理 NATS 消息
description: Drain pending NATS messages from a producer contract via NATS MCP tools. Discovers the available NATS tool capabilities, selects exact-subject or wildcard mode from .cortex/nats.yaml, applies Tolerant Reader semantics, executes ack/nak/term decisions, and returns aggregated stats.

purpose: 去除内部上下文，形成可独立使用的表达
description: Convert text with private context or internal dependencies into generic, unbiased expressions that are standalone and reusable. Core goal - produce decontextualized text that preserves logic while removing organizational identifiers. Use for project handoff, open-source prep, methodology abstraction, cross-team sharing.

purpose: 拆解问题、核实来源并形成研究结论
description: Investigate an open question through scoped decomposition, source selection, corroboration, and traceable findings without making a product decision.

purpose: 建立项目文档维护规范
description: Create or update docs/ARTIFACT_NORMS.md from an approved proposal and establish project docs norms as canonical rules.

purpose: 明确项目为什么存在
description: Define the fundamental purpose of a project or organization. Answers why the project exists; produces a single mission statement persisted to docs.

purpose: 定义代表用户核心价值的指标
description: Define the single most important metric representing the core value delivered to users. Produces North Star Metric with rationale, optional supporting metrics, and anti-pattern examples; persisted to docs.

purpose: 设计路线图结构，或在既定结构中填充计划
description: Design roadmap structure, populate source-backed content on a settled layout, or complete both stages; first-align existing plans while preserving business decisions and stable links, with optional local generation.

purpose: 将愿景转为少量战略主题
description: Derive 3–5 strategic pillars (high-level themes) from vision and North Star that structure and guide strategic goals and roadmap. Produces a strategic pillars document; persisted to docs.

purpose: 描述项目希望创造的未来
description: Define the long-term future the project aims to create. Answers what future we are building; produces a vision statement aligned with mission, persisted to docs.

purpose: 将功能分支交付到主分支
description: From inside a linked worktree, deliver the current feature branch into main — merge with --no-ff, push, and optionally clean up the worktree, all without leaving CWD.

purpose: 设计推动愿景实现的长期目标
description: Define 3–5 long-term strategic goals that move the project toward the vision and North Star. Produces a goals document aligned with mission, vision, and NSM; persisted to docs.

purpose: 编写智能体进入项目时读取的说明
description: Write or revise AGENTS.md with project identity, authoritative sources, behavioral expectations and verified loading entries for adopted workflows. Use when creating, auditing or revising a project's agent entry, including AI Cortex adoption.

purpose: 生成权限克制、版本固定的 GitHub 工作流
description: GitHub Actions YAML with embedded output contract: security-first, minimal permissions, version pinning. For CI, release, PR checks. Differs from generic templates by spec compliance and auditability.

purpose: 生成简洁、信息明确的项目 README
description: Generate lean, high-density README. Sections pruned by value threshold — not fixed count. Primary goal — reader knows what the project is, where to look, and how to use it within 30 seconds.

purpose: 按选择整合多个分支并清理工作区
description: From the main repo on the main branch, scan all linked worktrees and local branches, let the user multi-select, then merge --no-ff + push them sequentially and clean up succeeded worktrees together.

purpose: 在本机钥匙串中管理个人凭据
description: Store, look up, rotate, or delete a personal credential — passwords, API keys, tokens, certificate passphrases — in the macOS Keychain under a project-env-kind naming scheme. Use it even when the user does not say "Keychain". Not for team vaults, CI secret injection, or cross-machine sync.

purpose: 识别工作项依赖并判断推进条件
description: Identify dependencies among backlog and roadmap items across five categories, record depends_on and required-deliverable evidence, and assess next-step readiness with need-by dates and reduction options before promotion.

purpose: 研究市场、需求、客户与规模
description: Define a market and examine customers, demand, segments, trends, and defensible size estimates with transparent evidence.

purpose: 编排工程审查并汇总发现
description: Orchestrator skill — sequence atomic review-* skills into the post-coding engineering gate and aggregate their findings; functional alignment and acceptance verification remain separate.

purpose: 执行一项已确定的治理行动
description: Safely advances one governance action from plan-next, re-diagnoses stale or conflicting routes, and reports whether to continue, ask, wait, or stop.

purpose: 修复实现并复核工程与功能质量
description: Iteratively converge the sibling engineering and functional gates, apply targeted fixes, then re-review and re-verify until both pass or a stop condition is reached.

purpose: 根据审查发现修复并复核需求
description: Run a bounded requirements review, targeted repair and re-review loop until the requirement passes or needs a business decision. Use for repairing existing requirement documents from review findings, before design or implementation.

purpose: 协调路线图结构设计、内容规划与既有计划对齐
description: Route roadmap structure-only, content-on-settled-structure, continuous planning or existing-project alignment through scoped atomic skills; preserve decisions, links and authorization boundaries.

purpose: 分析治理现状并建议下一步
description: Analyze governance state and suggest next actions; ask whether a skipped recommendation lasts for the session or until revoked.

purpose: 研究政策适用范围与产品影响
description: Research a jurisdiction's policy or compliance question with official sources, effective dates, applicability, and product implications.

purpose: 依据产品事实准备售前问卷和支撑材料
description: Prepare evidence-backed presales questionnaire answers and supporting materials, maintain reusable product knowledge, and separate customer-specific terms from product facts. Use for capability, operations, service and procurement inquiries before delivery.

purpose: 构建并验证发布材料包
description: Build and validate a Release Package from repository history, version policy, quality gates, and optional release artifacts; does not publish or announce.

purpose: 依据项目策略确定待办优先级
description: Apply a project's priority policy to unresolved backlog items, or explicitly reassess a batch using RICE, WSJF, MoSCoW and ICE; preserve settled decisions unless replacement is requested.

purpose: 协调多项研究，形成产品机会分析材料
description: Coordinate relevant research lenses and deliver a traceable Opportunity Package for a product or feature decision.

purpose: 将已排序且条件就绪的工作纳入路线图
description: Promote prioritized requirements and defects into Now/Next/Later using settled project priorities and dependency readiness; preserve version membership and timing commitments.

purpose: 按跨团队契约发布 NATS 消息
description: Publish a NATS message conforming to a cross-team contract, using NATS MCP tools. Authors the contract on first use if missing. Reads project-level cache (.cortex/nats.yaml) to avoid re-prompting basics across sessions.

purpose: 验证就绪的发布包并执行正式发布
description: Validate a ready Release Package and execute the repository's publication steps—tag, build, package, and provider release—with explicit mutation gates.

purpose: 识别项目构建与本地部署方式后更新运行环境
description: After code changes, auto-detect the project's build system and local deployment method for a given directory, then build the project and restart its locally-deployed environment (Docker Compose / systemd / process manager). Never assumes — asks only when detection is ambiguous. Caches detected commands per project in .cortex/redeploy-local.yaml; re-invocations on the same project skip re-scanning until signal files change, the cache expires (30 days), or the skill version bumps.

purpose: 审查并改进技能的设计与组织
description: Audit and refactor one or more existing SKILL.md files for Agent Skills format compliance, clear execution, local asset boundaries, and portable tool use. Use when a user asks to refine, audit, or repair skill design.

purpose: 审查模块职责、依赖方向与契约边界
description: Review code against the canonical architecture quality Rule set, including boundaries, dependency direction, cohesion, cycles, contract stability, coupling, composition, change surface, unreachable code and deprecation discipline. Cognitive-only atomic skill; output is a findings list.

purpose: 审查代码库的组织与技术债
description: Review given file/dir/repo for current-state code organization: module boundaries, design patterns, cross-module dependencies, tech debt, and interface stability. Scope-only atomic skill; output is a findings list.

purpose: 审查本次差异的正确性与影响
description: Review only git diff for impact, regression, correctness, compatibility, and side effects. Scope-only atomic skill; output is a findings list for aggregation.

purpose: 审查 .NET 语言与运行时约定
description: Review .NET (C#/F#) code for language and runtime conventions: async/await, nullable, API versioning, IDisposable, LINQ, and testability. Language-only atomic skill; output is a findings list.

purpose: 审查错误发现位置与可行动的报错
description: Review code against the canonical error surfacing quality Rule set, covering boundary decisions on untrusted input, stopping on a broken invariant, detection layer, and messages a person or a program can act on. Cognitive-only atomic skill; output is a findings list.

purpose: 审查功能设计的完整性与可执行性
description: Review an existing functional design against its modeling Spec and canonical quality Rule before technical design begins. Evaluative atomic skill; outputs findings without rewriting.

purpose: 审查 Go 语言、并发与资源使用
description: Review Go code for language and runtime conventions: concurrency, context usage, error handling, resource management, API stability, type semantics, and testability. Language-only atomic skill; output is a findings list.

purpose: 核对实现与已批准需求、设计和验证依据
description: Compare an implemented change and its verification evidence with approved requirements, designs and tasks. Post-coding atomic functional-alignment review; outputs findings without repairing.

purpose: 审查 Java 语言与运行时约定
description: Review Java code for language and runtime conventions: concurrency, exceptions, try-with-resources, API versioning, collections and Streams, NIO, and testability. Language-only atomic skill; output is a findings list.

purpose: 审查日志、指标、追踪与问题定位能力
description: Review production telemetry against the canonical observability quality Rule set, including structured outcomes, correlation, SLIs, tracing, data safety, error ownership and background-work visibility.

purpose: 审查 ORM 查询、连接和事务使用
description: Review ORM usage patterns for N+1 queries, connection management, migration safety, transaction handling, and query efficiency. Library-level atomic skill; output is a findings list.

purpose: 审查计算、内存、I/O 与并发成本
description: Review code against the canonical performance quality Rule set, covering bounded work, I/O amplification, complexity, memory, concurrency, caching, budgets and resource ownership.

purpose: 审查 PHP 类型、异常与模块约定
description: Review PHP code for language and runtime conventions: strict types, error handling, resource management, PSR standards, namespaces, null safety, generators, and testability. Language-only atomic skill; output is a findings list.

purpose: 审查 PowerShell 参数、对象流与错误处理
description: Review PowerShell code for language and runtime conventions: advanced functions, parameter design, error handling, object pipeline behavior, compatibility, and testability. Language-only atomic skill; output is a findings list.

purpose: 审查 Python 类型、异常和异步约定
description: Review Python code for language and runtime conventions: type hints, exceptions, async/await, context managers, dependencies, and testability. Language-only atomic skill; output is a findings list.

purpose: 审查 React 组件、状态、Hooks 与可访问性
description: Review React code for component design, hooks correctness, state management, rendering performance, and accessibility. Framework-only atomic skill; output is a findings list.

purpose: 审查超时、重试、幂等与故障隔离
description: Review failure behavior against the canonical reliability quality Rule set, including timeouts, retries, idempotency, partial failure, isolation, dead letters, fault tests and release objectives.

purpose: 审查需求是否明确、完整且可验证
description: Review an existing requirement document against its modeling Spec and canonical quality Rule before design begins. Evaluative atomic skill; outputs findings without rewriting.

purpose: 审查路线图结构与计划内容
description: Review roadmap structure, business content or both with separate scoped conclusions; check source-backed planning and selected views without rewriting or expanding authorization.

purpose: 审查信任边界、权限与敏感数据处理
description: Review code and configuration against the canonical security quality Rule set. Resolves trust-boundary profiles, gathers tool-assisted evidence and emits findings traceable to stable Rule IDs.

purpose: 审查 SQL 安全、查询效率与事务语义
description: Review SQL and query code for injection risk, parameterization, indexing and performance, transactions, NULL and constraints, and dialect portability. Language-only atomic skill; output is a findings list.

purpose: 审查任务覆盖、依赖与执行条件
description: Review an existing task list against its modeling Spec and canonical quality Rule before assignment or coding, including design coverage, affected scope, Rule references and verification evidence.

purpose: 审查架构、接口与技术取舍
description: Review an existing technical design against its modeling Spec, canonical quality Rule and applicable engineering Rule profiles before tasks or coding begin.

purpose: 审查测试是否证明了真实行为
description: Review changed behavior and tests against the canonical testing quality Rule set, including direct oracles, boundary paths, integration assembly, contracts, determinism, doubles and coverage evidence.

purpose: 审查 TypeScript 与 JavaScript 类型和异步逻辑
description: Review TypeScript/JavaScript code for type safety, async patterns, error handling, and module design. Atomic skill; output is a findings list.

purpose: 审查 Vue 组件、响应式状态与渲染
description: Review Vue 3 code for Composition API, reactivity, components, state (Pinia), routing, and performance. Framework-only atomic skill; output is a findings list.

purpose: 依据智能体测试契约生成测试套件
description: Generate an LLM agent test suite (golden cases, mock-LLM unit tests, evaluator harness) from an agent implementation and its agent-test contract. Use when an agent has no tests, or a contract exists but the test code is missing.

purpose: 维护工作项状态、日期和变更依据
description: Maintain requirement-and-defect roadmap summaries — change item status, shift dates with downstream impact analysis, and retain source-backed revision history. Does not move items between Now/Next/Later tiers.
